# Sample Quest (synthetic fixture game)

A tiny, made-up RPG Maker MZ layout: no real game files, nothing runs. `Game.exe` is a text stub.
The registry's sample pack (`ailocalpack/registry`, `games/fp-<fingerprint>/ru/sample-quest-ru`) targets this folder,
so its fingerprint and file hashes must not change: `.gitattributes` turns off line-ending conversion here.
Changing any file here breaks that pack's compatibility check.
